presentation: Single portable floor lantern. Neutral outer material presentation, warm candle illumination inside only. No environment, ground light pool or cast shadow.
intended_3d_pivot: Centre of the flat bottom plane of the base.
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Primary request: Transfer the EXACT painterly fantasy game-prop style of the supplied concepts to ONE freestanding portable FLOOR LANTERN that can be placed anywhere in the camp. One whole assembled lantern, isolated as a transparent PNG reference for Tripo.
Input roles: Image 1 (smithy) is a STYLE reference, especially the simple chunky lantern visible on its left. Redesign that visual language into a sturdy standing floor lantern. Image 2 (anvil) is a reference for thick bevelled dark metal and broad painted material planes. Image 3 (wooden bucket) is a reference for chunky carved honey-coloured timber, oversized rivets and a robust handle. Do NOT reproduce the smithy, forge, anvil, bucket, flag or scenery.
Style is critical: hand-painted stylized 3D fantasy game concept art, thick chunky BEVELED geometry, deliberately carved broad polygonal facets, bold painterly colour planes, broad visible brush strokes, a few large drawn material accents. Warm honey/ochre timber and plain dark desaturated iron exactly as in the references. Clean strong silhouette that reads at the high gameplay camera. NO photorealism, NO PBR product render, NO microtexture, NO fine noisy scratches, NO realistic wood pores or textile, NO photographic glass reflections or refraction, NO thick black comic outlines.
Design: a compact heavy-duty travelling lantern, approximately 65 centimetres tall including its raised handle and 40 centimetres across the base. A wide low FLAT stable base with a narrow chunky honey-brown timber rim and plain iron protective shoe, no narrow individual feet. A squat four-sided lantern body stands centered over the base. Four thick bevelled dark iron corner supports, oversized simple round rivets and broad framed window openings on all four sides. A short shallow bevelled metal top cap, minimal overhang so it does not obscure the warm interior from above. One big solid forged arch handle attached securely at the top, with an unmistakable open hole and substantial thickness. No chain, no thin filigree. The overall shape is wider below and compact, not a tall lamp post or hanging fixture.
Light source: one simple stout cream wax candle inside a small plain metal dish, with one clear warm amber-yellow flame. The inner candle and warm translucent amber window surfaces should be readable from the high view. Keep frame, window inserts and central candle visually distinct for subsequent 3D modelling. The windows are simple painted translucent colour planes, without glass glare. Warm illumination is confined to the INTERIOR surfaces, with a softly golden core. NO bloom halo, no radiating glow outside the silhouette, no lighting beams, no smoke, sparks or floating flame particles.
Camera and framing: single orthographic-like elevated front three-quarter view about 45 to 48 degrees above horizontal, similar to our gameplay camera. Show top, broad front and side windows, the entire base and full handle. Large windows and shallow top keep the visible luminous centre readable from this high camera. Entire object centered in a high-resolution square image with comfortable transparent margins, no crop. Exactly one lantern, no variant sheet, no multiple views, no diagram.
Presentation: even neutral colour visibility of outer materials, broad painted form shading and edge accents like the references, no directional sunlight or sunset wash. The flame is the only luminous content. No cast shadow beneath the object, no orange light pool, no ground or background lighting.
Background: genuine transparent alpha around the whole object and through the handle hole. No opaque black, white or coloured backdrop, no checkerboard, gradient, floor, ground plane, rug, pedestal, plants, environment or horizon.
Hard exclusions: flags, banners, heraldry, coats of arms, emblems, symbols, runes, labels, text, logos, watermark, signs, characters, animals, weapons, cables, attached posts or wall brackets. This is a standalone portable floor light, not a structure fixed to the environment.
